source.description: Independent adversarial review of debugger commit 6129ebb1 on branch fix/unitAI-34pyf-extension-tool-grants, based on RC af65334b. Review live tree and full af65334b..6129ebb1 diff. Verify no dead code, stale generic-forwarding reimplementation, dirty/generated drift, unresolved TODOs, or unrelated changes. Confirm the minimal --exclude-tools strategy preserves native tier restrictions, only activates when extensionSources is non-empty, works identically in PiAgentSession and direct script/serve, does not accidentally expose denied built-ins, and makes arbitrary explicitly enabled extension tools callable without hard-coded sources. Verify required_tools downgrade behavior, extension advisory accuracy/trust wording, malformed/unhealthy source behavior, source ordering, offline behavior, and no regression to --no-extensions. Inspect all tests for theatre; rerun focused tests, tsc, full unit suite as practical, and model-backed extension-grant test if credentials available. Check git status and exact pushed commit. Treat configured source=true as the operator trust signal; no per-tool grant schema. Review advisory feature unitAI-kaae7 only insofar as commit 6129ebb1 implements it. Return PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL with blockers and exact citations. READ-ONLY: do not edit or commit.
